bottleneck.description: Automotive ADAS lidar leader with ~33% overall, 43% long-range ADAS and 61% robotaxi share, but RoboSense, Huawei and Seyond contest the market and Chinese lidar supply is geopolitically gated for Western buyers.

dependency.key_customers: Li Auto, Xiaomi, BYD, Geely, Chery, Zoox (Amazon), Aurora, WeRide, Pony, Apollo (Baidu), Didi
dependency.key_suppliers: Sony/Sumitomo (lasers/photodetectors), Chinese optical component vendors, MEMS/SiPM suppliers

editorial.notes: Hesai is the world's #1 long-range ADAS and robotaxi lidar supplier (5 consecutive years), with 1.6M+ unit shipments and 4M-unit 2026 capacity plan, supplying Li Auto, Xiaomi, BYD, Zoox, Aurora, WeRide and Pony. However, RoboSense holds #1 passenger-car volume share, Huawei and Seyond are credible competitors, and customers routinely dual-source. Chinese-supplier dominance (95% of automotive lidar) creates geopolitical switching friction for Western customers (mirrors TSEM-type regional concentration logic). Not a structural monopoly so MEDIUM rather than HIGH.
